provenance.pipeline: satsuki v1 (v1.0.1 editorial re-edit: usage-note reshaping corpus-wide, lane discrimination for same-surface families, against prompts/style.md)

patterns.usage_note: Repeats a report as received, with no hedging and no evidence of the speaker's own, and attaches to plain forms (降ったそうだ, いいそうだ, 学生だそうだ). The look-alike conjecture そうだ attaches instead to the masu-stem or the adjective stem (降りそうだ, よさそうだ) and inflects like a な-adjective. This hearsay form has essentially only 〜そうだ／〜そうで: no prenominal 〜そうな, and no negative of its own.

examples.ruby: 北[きた]の山[やま]では、ゆうべ初雪[はつゆき]が降[ふ]ったそうだ。
examples.english: They say the first snow of the year fell in the northern mountains last night.

examples.ruby: 山口[やまぐち]さんの娘[むすめ]さんは、ピアノがとても上手[じょうず]だそうです。
examples.english: I hear Ms. Yamaguchi's daughter is very good at the piano.

examples.ruby: 駅[えき]の前[まえ]に、来年[らいねん]新[あたら]しいパン屋[や]ができるそうだ。
examples.english: They say a new bakery is opening in front of the station next year.
